ResearchTabDef.label: Mycology
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Study the forbidden mushrooms: how to grow them, how to prepare them, and how to remove their downsides.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mycology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the forbidden fungi. Unlocks the three branches of cap cultivation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: combat fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow ragecap, ironhide cap and ghostcap, and bundle them into combat packages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: refined combat fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Steep ragecap, ironhide cap and ghostcap in shroom broth to remove their downsides, in single caps or refined combat packages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: restorative fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow mender's bonnet, nightcap and hollowcap, and bundle them into recovery packages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: refined restorative fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Steep mender's bonnet, nightcap and hollowcap in shroom broth to remove their downsides, in single caps or refined recovery packages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cognitive fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow dreamcap and sagecap, and bundle them into mind packages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: refined cognitive fungi
ResearchProjectDef.description: Steep dreamcap and sagecap in shroom broth to remove their downsides, in single caps or refined mind packages.
